import pandas as pd
import os

# Load beneficiaries
beneficiaries_path = '/data/beneficiaries.csv'
payments_path = '/data/payments.xlsx'

beneficiaries = pd.read_csv(beneficiaries_path)
# Check columns
print("Beneficiaries columns:", beneficiaries.columns.tolist())
print("Beneficiaries shape:", beneficiaries.shape)

# Load payments sheet Disbursements
payments = pd.read_excel(payments_path, sheet_name='Disbursements')
print("\nPayments columns:", payments.columns.tolist())
print("Payments shape:", payments.shape)
print(payments.head())

# Clean status
payments['Status_clean'] = payments['Status'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
paid_payments = payments[payments['Status_clean'] == 'paid'].copy()

# Merge with beneficiaries
merged = paid_payments.merge(beneficiaries, on='Beneficiary ID', how='inner', suffixes=('_pay','_ben'))

# Filter Girls' Education and Odisha
# Programme column in beneficiaries
mask = (merged['Programme'] == "Girls' Education") & (merged['State'] == 'Odisha')
filtered = merged[mask]

# Sum amount
# Amount column name?
amount_col = 'Amount (INR)'
if amount_col not in filtered.columns:
    # find similar
    amount_col = [c for c in filtered.columns if 'Amount' in c][0]
print("Amount column:", amount_col)
total = filtered[amount_col].sum()
print("Filtered rows:", len(filtered))
print("Total amount:", total)

# Also show breakdown maybe
print(filtered[['Beneficiary ID','Full Name','State','Programme','Amount (INR)']].head())

import pandas as pd
import re

payments_path = '/data/payments.xlsx'
beneficiaries_path = '/data/beneficiaries.csv'

beneficiaries = pd.read_csv(beneficiaries_path)
# Ensure beneficiary IDs are strings stripped
beneficiaries['Beneficiary ID'] = beneficiaries['Beneficiary ID'].astype(str).str.strip()

payments = pd.read_excel(payments_path, sheet_name='Disbursements', header=4)
payments.columns = payments.columns.str.strip()

# Clean Beneficiary ID
payments['Beneficiary ID'] = payments['Beneficiary ID'].astype(str).str.strip()

# Clean Status
payments['Status_clean'] = payments['Status'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()

# Filter paid
paid = payments[payments['Status_clean'] == 'paid'].copy()

# Keep only rows with beneficiary ID in beneficiaries
valid_ids = set(beneficiaries['Beneficiary ID'])
paid = paid[paid['Beneficiary ID'].isin(valid_ids)]

# Clean Amount
def clean_amount(x):
    if pd.isna(x):
        return None
    s = str(x)
    # Remove currency symbols, commas, spaces
    s = re.sub(r'[^\d\.]', '', s)
    return float(s) if s else None

paid['Amount_clean'] = paid['Amount (INR)'].apply(clean_amount)

# Merge
merged = paid.merge(beneficiaries, on='Beneficiary ID', how='inner')

# Filter Girls' Education and Odisha
filtered = merged[(merged['Programme'] == "Girls' Education") & (merged['State'] == 'Odisha')]

total = filtered['Amount_clean'].sum()
print("Rows filtered:", len(filtered))
print("Total amount paid:", total)
# Show some examples
print(filtered[['Beneficiary ID','Full Name','State','Programme','Amount (INR)','Amount_clean']].head(20))
